AI provider, for recap text To write your recap, the text is sent to our AI provider, which processes it to produce the result. Update Bi-weekly check-in 4 phases · 6 questions PHASES pulse Pulse How is the last stretch sitting — fast read. 1 q friction Friction Where is anything snagging — work, energy, people. 2 q momentum Momentum What's moving forward and what's stuck. 2 q lift Lift Closer. What would make the next two weeks lighter or sharper. 1 q TONE Casual, fluent, peer-tempered. The manager is checking in, not auditing. Short questions, plain words. Willing to go deeper if something opens, but no agenda performance. ANTI-PATTERNS Agenda-heavy openers that read like a HR form.
